description: Resolve country and area names to Comtrade M49 numeric codes used in all data queries. Accepts a partial or full name, an official name (e.g. "Republic of Korea"), a common name (e.g. "UK", "Turkey"), or an ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 code (e.g. "USA", "US"), ignoring case and accents; exact matches are listed before partial ones. Returns matching entries with their numeric code, ISO identifiers, a validAsReporter flag, and validity dates; within the exact and partial groups, historical entities such as Fed. Rep. of Germany (...1990) are listed after current ones. World (code 0) is a valid partner but not a valid reporter, while some groupings, such as the European Union (97), do report — check validAsReporter. Use this before any trade data tool that requires reporter_code or partner_code. To aggregate across all partners, use partner code 0 (World) — no lookup needed.

include_groups.description: Whether to include regional and economic groupings (e.g. EU, ASEAN). Set to false to return only individual countries; a grouping listed as the code a match’s trade is published under (490 Other Asia, nes for 158 Taiwan, Province of China) is kept.

query.description: Country or area to find: a name or name fragment, an official or common name, or an ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 code. Case, accents, and surrounding spaces are ignored. Examples: "Germany", "DEU", "DE", "south korea", "Turkiye".

role.description: Filter by role: "reporter" returns only codes valid for reporter_code; "partner" returns only codes valid for partner_code, which include World (0) but not reporter-only groupings such as the European Union (97) and ASEAN (975); "any" returns every match.

name: comtrade_lookup_countries

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Matching entries, plus entries sharing an ISO-3 code with a match and the code UN Comtrade publishes a match’s trade under (490 Other Asia, nes for 158 Taiwan, Province of China). Exact matches (a common name, ISO code, name, or official long-form name equal to the query) come before partial-name matches, and an entry a match pulls in ranks with that match. Within each rank: reporter-valid first, current before expired (entryExpiredDate before today), then name and code.

items.description: A country or area entry with its Comtrade M49 code and identifiers.

entryEffectiveDate.description: First day the entity is valid in UN Comtrade reference data (YYYY-MM-DD), when upstream lists one.

entryExpiredDate.description: Last day the entity was valid (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. 1990-12-31 for Fed. Rep. of Germany (...1990); absent when upstream records no expiry.

id.description: M49 numeric code to use in trade data queries.

isGroup.description: Whether this entry is a geographic or economic grouping rather than a single country.

name.description: Display name of the country or area.

note.description: The catalog’s long-form name or coverage note, e.g. "France, Monaco" for 251 France; a match can come from it. Absent when the catalog gives none or it repeats the name.

validAsReporter.description: Whether this code is valid as a reporter_code in trade data queries. Most groupings (isGroup=true) are partner-only, though some report, such as the European Union (97).

notice.description: Recovery hint when no matches are found, echoing the query and suggesting alternatives; or, when UN Comtrade publishes a match’s trade under another code (158 Taiwan, Province of China under 490 Other Asia, nes), the code to query.

title: Lookup Countries / Areas
